title: La Liga investigating incident of alleged racist abuse in Elche vs. Espanyol
content:
La Liga is investigating after Espanyol defender Omar El Hilali alleged he was racially abused by Elche striker Rafa Mir during Sunday’s fixture.

Espanyol defender Omar El Hilali reported to referee Iosu Galech Apezteguia that he had been racially abused, with the official subsequently performing the “No racism” gesture, crossing his arms in an ‘X’ shape.

This initiates a three-step protocol, stopping the match. Games can then be suspended or even abandoned if the abuse persists.

According to the referee’s report, El Hilali — who was born in Spain to Moroccan parents and represents Morocco internationally — alleged that Mir had directed an anti-immigrant insult towards him.

Galech Apezteguia’s report stated: “In the 78th minute, Espanyol player Omar El Hilali tells me that Rafa Mir approached him and said, ‘You came here on a small boat’”.

The referee added that the alleged abuse was not heard by any of the refereeing team, which prevents action from being taken on the field.

Elche have been approached for comment by The Athletic.

The game was halted for around three minutes before play resumed. Mir went on to score the equaliser from the penalty spot in the 90th minute.

During the game, Espanyol posted in support of El Hilali on social media. After full-time, La Liga posted an anti-racism message on its X account, condemning any racist act.

This comes after Real Madrid forward Vinicius Junior alleged that he was racially abused by Benfica’s Gianluca Prestianni in the Champions League play-off first leg between the two teams on February 17. Prestianni has denied racially abusing Vinicius Jr.

UEFA subsequently confirmed that it would open an investigation into the alleged offence, which carries a minimum suspension length of 10 games if proven. Prestianni was then provisionally suspended “without prejudice” by UEFA for one match and missed the second leg.

Vinicius Jr has often faced racist abuse in Spain. According to La Liga, since October 2021, there have been 26 incidents of racist abuse directed towards him, at 10 different football grounds in Spain.
